description:
Operation IDs listed here or in receipts are names only. Before the first call to each operation in this conversation, call elevenlabs_discover_api with that operation_id to read its contract, unless a tool description or receipt already supplies the exact parameter names and locations. Never infer path_params, query_params or body fields from an operation name.
Place or schedule phone calls, register a live call connection, or send WhatsApp calls and template messages using an admitted operation_id.
WHEN TO USE: carry out the user's requested contact with the specified recipients. Inspect the operation contract first. Batch submission schedules recipient contacts; retry calls failed or unanswered recipients again. Provider acceptance does not prove that a person answered or received a message. Registration returns connection instructions and does not itself prove an outbound dial occurred. These actions can reach real people, use paid services and create recordings or conversation records according to the supplied configuration. A timeout does not mean the action failed. No retries or polling are automatic.
RELATED TOOLS: elevenlabs_discover_api, elevenlabs_read_resource, elevenlabs_change_resource.
EXAMPLE: {"operation_id":"register_twilio_call","body":{"agent_id":"agent_example","from_number":"+12025550100","to_number":"+12025550101","direction":"inbound"}}
COST: calls, messages and provider services may incur charges.

body.description: The provider request body for this operation, preserving its schema, arrays and nulls. Omit for bodyless operations; local file operands belong in files.

path_params.description: Declared path parameter names and nonempty string values; inspect this operation with elevenlabs_discover_api.

query_params.description: Declared query parameter names with string, number, boolean, null or scalar-array values. Arrays repeat; null is omitted.
